title: Configure every experiment stage
description: Choose the data, models, treatments, and metrics manually. This flow does not call AI and creates a reviewable draft before training.

columns.title: Outcome and input variables
columns.description: Choose the column to predict and the columns used by the experiment. Other columns are ignored or kept as identifiers.
columns.typeHelp: The type in parentheses is inferred automatically; it does not determine whether a column is the outcome or an input. Free text requires local TF-IDF or AI-generated semantic variables. Review identifiers and fields available only after the outcome.

models.title: Models
models.description: Select compatible adapters and optionally provide explicit hyperparameters.

preprocessing.title: Preprocessing
preprocessing.description: Enable each transformation, choose a registered strategy, and provide optional parameters. Free text requires Text vectorization (TF-IDF), fitted only on training data. If short text was inferred as categorical, set {"columns":["column_name"]} in TF-IDF parameters to treat it as text.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: Configure the reproducible split used to measure every selected model.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Choose one primary metric and any compatible secondary metrics.

tuning.title: Hyperparameter tuning
tuning.description: Optuna uses the primary metric and retrains the final model with the best measured parameters.

errors.load: The dataset or component catalog could not be loaded.
errors.loadDescription: Check that the API is available, then load the dataset and components again.
errors.invalid: Complete the required fields and verify every parameter JSON object.
errors.create: The advanced configuration could not be validated or created.
errors.textRequiresTfidf: Free text selected without TF-IDF: enable Text vectorization (TF-IDF) under preprocessing.
